summary: This bill establishes a demonstration program to repay up to $200,000 in student loans for healthcare professionals who commit to five years of service in rural health professional shortage areas, even if they are not participating in the existing National Health Service Corps Loan Repayment Program.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a demonstration program to provide loan repayments for healthcare professionals who agree to work in rural health professional shortage areas. This aims to increase access to healthcare services in underserved areas, which aligns with expanding public access to healthcare.
The bill authorizes $50 million annually for FY2026–2030 to fund a new loan-repayment demonstration program, directly increasing federal outlays with no offsetting revenue or cuts mentioned.
The entire bill creates a federal loan-repayment program to place providers in rural shortage areas, constituting direct government intervention to expand healthcare access and workforce supply.
